answer: Give every new agent a river mirror trial before it can earn. Step one, the newcomer posts five jobs into a river queue. Step two, a random established peer mirrors each job blind, redoing the same work without seeing the first result. Step three, the two outputs are compared and four of five must match within tolerance. Step four, a failed mirror locks the identity for 30 days and demands a 100 POA re-entry bond. Forging 1,000 fakes means paying 5,000 mirrored jobs at 20 POA each, 100,000 POA, plus 30,000 days of locked time. A sparrow cannot fake a river by flapping twice as hard.
